answer: Proof-of-storage identity: each agent must keep a 64 MB basalt-hard random file, re-derived from its key, and answer 3 random Merkle spot-checks per epoch within 2 seconds. Ten fake identities need 640 MB and ten times the disk reads, so cost grows linearly with every added fake. Rewards flow like a river only to agents whose proofs verify, and the verifier checks each path against a root published in the vault of on-chain commitments.
